main_text.p: tingere. Sapè pro He habet Aleph. Niphal נִקְרָה Obvium exhibuit se, Obvium fieri. Pihel קָרָה Contignare, Contabulare. Hiphil הִקְרָה Obvenire fecit.
קֹרָה f. Tignum, Trabs: plur. קֹרוֹת.
מִקְרֶה m. Accidens, Eventus, Casus. קְרִי, קָרֶה קְרִיאָה f Occursus. מִקְרֶה m. Contignatio.
קִרְיָה f. Urbs, Civitas. Chald. idem: קִרְיתָא דְּ קִרְיָא מְדִינָא in urbe; בִּקְרִיָּה Civitas ista, civitas rebellis est, Esr. 4.10.15.
קָרַח Glabrare se, Calvitiū sibi inducere. Niphal נִקְרַח Glabrari, Calvitium induci. Hiphil הִקְרִיחַ Glabrum, Calvum effecit. Hophal Partic. מְקֹרָח Decalvatum.
קָרֵחַ m. Calvus. קַרְחָה קָרְחַת f. Calvitium.
קָרַן Radiare, Splendere. Hiphil הִקְרִין Cornua produxit, ex Nomine derivato.
קֶרֶן c. Cornu: metaphoricè Robur, quòd cornua sunt animalium robur: duale קַרְנַיִם , קַרְנַיִם, quia proprie duo cornua animalia gestant. Fœmin. קַרְנוֹת.
קָרַן Chal. idem: plur. קַרְנִין וְקַרְנָא.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek-style vowel pointing is partly faint on the scan; Hebrew forms transcribed as best legible. Several marginal ink spots obscure letters; the word "Calvitium" and some pointed forms may be inexact. Stains on the page ignored.
